title: MV How do I make a menu with pictures that shows variables within it?

posts.author: cronosus01
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I'm trying to make a Custom Menu in RPG Maker MV with pictures, that also shows custom stats based on the current values of a variable.
Something like the example below:
The bar at the top is optional, but I'm also thinking if there's a way to have a bar that shows the increasing level of a variable.
Would also like it if I could swap pictures by using a script/plugin command (for example changing the character picture with another one or adding a character level picture and changing it when the variable reaches a certain level).
Anyone has any idea how to do this? I've worked with RPG Maker since quite some years but I've never tried to make such a custom menu before.
Thank you!
